description: This Java source file defines the CollectionConverters class and several nested classes, providing various converter implementations for converting between collections, arrays, strings, and maps within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CollectionConverters
classes.description: Main class that implements ConverterLoader to register various collection-related converters.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Loads contained converters specific to collection conversions.

classes.name: ArrayCreator
classes.description: Creates converters to transform array types to List.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Registers this creator with the Converter registry.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter from array class to List if applicable.

classes.name: ArrayClassToList
classes.description: Converts an array of a specific component type to a List.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if the converter can convert given source and target classes.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Performs the conversion from array to List.

classes.name: ArrayToList
classes.description: Converts any object array to a List.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if source is an array and target is a List.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an array to a List using Arrays.asList.

classes.name: ListToString
classes.description: Converts a List to its String representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a List to String by calling toString().

classes.name: MapToList
classes.description: Wraps a Map in a List.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Returns a List containing the provided Map.

classes.name: MapToSet
classes.description: Wraps a Map in a Set.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Returns a Set containing the provided Map.

classes.name: MapToString
classes.description: Converts a Map to its String representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Returns the toString() of the Map.

classes.name: StringToList
classes.description: Converts a String to a List of Strings, parsing list syntax.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Parses string starting with [ and ending with ] into a List.

classes.name: StringToMap
classes.description: Converts a formatted String to a Map of String keys and values.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Parses a String formatted as {key1=value1, key2=value2} into a Map.

classes.name: StringToSet
classes.description: Converts a String to a Set of Strings, parsing set syntax.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Parses string starting with [ and ending with ] into a Set.
